programmes.d: Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.

Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends aboard the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. The trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.
Hosts Justin Leake and Travis Holeman highlight the coastal lifestyle and diverse fishing opportunities in Panama City Beach, Fla.
Andy visits the land of Scotland; he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette.
Andy and his son, Logan, visit the country of New Zealand; they explore vineyards, helicopter hunts and more.
Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.
Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.
Lights, camera, generator, crossbow... Action! This is one wild ride that anyone can have fun on. Come along on this nighttime bow hunting adventure in Crystal River Fl.
Brandon Branch chases yellowfin with the guys from Fishing Florida Charters.

In Grant, Fla., four million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon; they are paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash cleanups to help restore one of Florida's most critical ecosystems.
Focusing on the culture of fishing, as seen through the viewpoints of two drastically different fishermen.
How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting communities who rely on the yearly cycle.

Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

Documenting the story of the 350 Legend cartridge at deer camps across the Midwest with the Keefer Brothers in Kansas, Mark and Terry Drury in Missouri, Melissa Bachman in Nebraska and Team Winchester back in Missouri.
We head back to the Mecca of Jumbo Perch at Lake Cascade, ID!
Learning the fundamentals of flats fishing and the advanced tactics used by proven tournament anglers.
Capts. Scott and Steve fill up their Yeti cooler to make a big run from Plantation Boat Mart in the 36' Invincible into the green Gulf waters, hoping to do battle with some sea monsters.
A peaceful day of reef fishing in Islamorada turns into a kingfish and yellowtail frenzy for Captains Scott and Steve.
It only takes three fish to fill the Yeti cooler when Capt. Scott kite fishes the top for wahoo and Steve pulls a big mutton snapper off the bottom.
Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island to load their coolers with cobia and huge yellowtail snapper.
Captains Scott and Steve sail west of Key West to battle with big kingfish and end up with plenty of meat for the smoker.

Captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker prove themselves to be among the top charter boat and tournament captains in offshore fishing; follow their journey to fishing destinations as they share the techniques that have driven their success.
Mike fishes his home waters with special guest Leiza Fitzgerald from CCA Florida.
Capt. Danny leaves the boat at home in pursuit of some land-based fishing; he's joined by his cameraman for a day off on the beaches of Anna Maria Island.
Army veteran Dave Allen helps Paul Teutul Sr. from Orange County Choppers build a one-of-a-kind motorcycle to be revealed at the second annual Salute to American Heroes.
Chris Schmidt hunts for his largest whitetail to date during late season in Kansas!
The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

Randy is at home on the Raven planting food plots and trying to get everything on the farm ready for fall.
The boys are on the Raven in Missouri trying to plant 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in five days before heading out west to kick off the hunting season.
Randy and his brother Cody are at the Dirty Bird ranch in Oklahoma doing some summer time maintenance and trying their best to control the hog population by doing a little hog hunting.

The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of food plots in five days; Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.
Randy is in Oklahoma at the Dirty Bird ranch trying to take down a buck with his new Thompson Center Muzzleloader.

Capt. Blair goes back to Marco Island with Capt. Chris Broome to tackle the beautiful inshore spots before heading offshore the next day.

U.S. Army combat correspondent Ken Plant shares about being captured and tortured as a POW.
Operation Healing Heroes documents the lives of our US military veterans while offering assistance to those still struggling with the many forms of PTSD.
Patriotic Kenny, an 82-year-old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, discusses how he gifts mobility scooters to help fellow vets in need.
U.S. Army veteran Domingo Martinez recounts overcoming the life-altering effects of his childhood trauma.

Establishing themselves just after the last Ice Age, the blacktail of Vancouver Island offers an important genetic population isolated from the mainland. To explore the local relationship with the species, its harvesting, conservation and history...
Dan Cabela sets out to learn about the model of private ownership of wildlife in South Africa. Along the way, he participates in game capture, attends an auction and hunts to support a community.
Dan Cabela dives into the heart of one of the world's largest game reserves - the Selous. He explores the synergy between hunting and conservation that is preserving this wild paradise.
Join Dan Cabela in New Zealand's breathtaking landscapes as he hunts non-native species, delving into the crucial role of controlled harvesting and the complexities of managing introduced wildlife.
We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass through PCB's beautiful beach waters each summer. It's a lesson in humility, respect and yes, luck.
Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!
